## One pathway, connected subject courses

You can follow one recommended sequence or enter a subject course directly.
Stable outcomes and prerequisites connect every course; QMD lessons provide the
same full lesson material on the website and in generated Colab notebooks.

{{< include courses/_cards.qmd >}}

## What rigorous study means here

::: {.course-grid}
### Explain before calculating

Definitions, domains, hypotheses, and limitations remain visible. Worked
solutions show why each step follows, not only which operation to perform.

### Work manually and computationally

You first build an auditable mathematical argument, then use SymPy, NumPy, and
other appropriate tools to verify, explore, and scale the idea.

### Practice retrieval and synthesis

Topic-specific checkpoints sit near the concepts they test. Unit challenges and
cumulative mixed practice ask you to select methods independently.

### Keep control of your learning record

Completion stays in your browser without an account. Export, import, or reset it
at any time; raw answers and behavioral histories are not stored.
:::
